# Dknowledge

> Drayker's distributed memory across personal, project, local and global scales. This repository is the public surface for shared orientation, papers, architecture, decisions and evidence connected to their sources.

## Read in this order

- [Current orientation](https://dknowledge.drayker.org/CURRENT.html): the current reading boundary and status.
- [Direction](https://dknowledge.drayker.org/roadmap/DIRECTION.html): current direction without treating historical dates as commitments.
- [Papers](https://dknowledge.drayker.org/papers/): the public paper collection.
- [Historical roadmap](https://dknowledge.drayker.org/roadmap/global-main-roadmap.html): preserved context, not a current delivery promise.
- [Public repository](https://github.com/draykerdk/dknowledge): primary source and change history.

## Interpretation rules

- Current guidance, active research, proposals and historical material have different status.
- A documented architecture is not proof that a service is deployed.
- Every factual claim should remain traceable to its public source.
- Drayker is the system; Dk is its intelligence; Dk Network is its network.
- Personal context remains personal; the public repository is a shared junction, not one store that absorbs every member's memory.

## Crawling and citation

Public pages may be indexed and quoted with attribution. Prefer the most specific canonical page and link back to its source. The sitemap is at https://dknowledge.drayker.org/sitemap.xml.
